definitions.explanation: The eye on the right side of the face.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる。
examples.english: Tears well up in my right eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{右|みぎ}{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The ball hit me near my right eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かなった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦だるま→だるま：06539_daruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右|みぎ}{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{入|い}れた→書き入れる：13052_kakiireru⟧。
examples.english: Since my wish came true, I filled in the daruma's right eye.

notes:
Refers to the right eye from the point of view of the person whose eye it is.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右|みぎ}{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つぶる→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧: to close/wink the right eye
- {右|みぎ}{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視力|しりょく}→視力：05033_shiryoku⟧: vision in the right eye

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{左|ひだり}{目|め}→左目：29955_hidarime⟧: left eye
- ⟦{両目|りょうめ}→両目：21275_ryoume⟧: both eyes
